correctness.rationale: Direct Lie differentiation gives u_dot=alpha*z*u/2, X_dot=-sigma*Y, Y_dot=sigma*X, theta_dot=-Omega with analytic inverse for X>-a^2. Full oscillator circles stay in that half-plane iff rho<a^2. For rho>=a^2 the allowed angular arc has exact length 2 arccos(-a^2/rho), or 2pi at tangency; endpoints correspond to divergent u. Taylor expansions of the oscillator at transverse versus tangent hits give the separate half-power and first-power radial escape rates and the displayed z asymptotics. On-axis Riccati is elementary. The packaged checker confirms algebra and finite illustrative evaluations; the proof is analytic.
